script: Brag about how you'll just outbid me? Fine, I'll just outplay you.. I was at a charity auction for a niche world last weekend. The vibe was all brash, loud, and lit—everyone was vibing, laughing, and throwing bids like it was a TikTok dance battle. Steve, the celebrity of this little universe, was everywhere. He'd already snagged half the silent‑auction items and only raised each bid by a single dollar. Classic mic drop. I was eyeing a quirky home‑decor piece I'd already bid on a few times. I was ready to drop my next bid when a woman—Steve's wing‑woman—stood right in front of it. She slapped my bid up, then planted her hands on the table like a guard dog on a squeaky toy. Okaaaaay, whatever. I shot her a grin. "Ah, you really want it, huh? Man, I see your name everywhere. Just give up if you see Steve's name!" Steve, like a boss, leaned in. "Yeah, I've got three people watching the tables and bidding for me." I kept my cool. "Should I even bother to try bidding on it any more?" He smirked. "You can, but I'll just outbid you." I rolled my eyes. "Fine, Steve, you can keep your ego. I'll just outplay you." Fast forward to the last 60 seconds. Steve was gone, so I sprinted to the table, heart racing. A different woman—also Steve's assigned bidder—just finished writing a bid. I snatched her paper and slipped in my own with one second to spare. "WOOO HOOOOOO!" I screamed, arms flying. I felt a tiny pang for the woman who didn't follow Steve's orders, but the trophy was mine. I outplayed him, literally. And now it's on my wall, bestie.
